- Overestimate prices after recent sentiment spikes (positive sentiment → model tends to overshoot).
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative or trending down (especially after sharp drops).
- Model exhibits lag in reacting to sentiment shifts — delays in adjusting forecasts when sentiment turns.
- Mean reversion bias: model often holds prices too high after recent peaks, especially when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.
- Overshoots after strong upward sentiment moves — model forecasts peak too early and too high.
- Underestimates in low-sentiment periods — model fails to account for downward pressure when sentiment is negative or flat.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overreact to short-term sentiment, underreacting to longer-term structural trends.
- When sentiment is volatile or erratic, model tends to smooth too much, missing sharp reversals.
